title: Gurugram Police arrest 81 people allegedly linked to online fraud networks across states
date_note: The page gives only the day officials spoke (Monday); the arrests were made over 21 days this month.
geo_basis: police force's city, as the article states
summary: Gurugram Police arrested 81 persons within a span of 21 days this month, officials said on Monday, in a PTI report carried by Rediff. The police say the arrestees were allegedly linked with online fraud networks operating across states. Devices used in cybercrimes were recovered, and investigations are ongoing, the report says.
plain: Police in Gurugram, India, say they arrested 81 people in 21 days over alleged online fraud networks, and are still investigating.
exec: Enforcement news only; the report names fraud types such as sham investment schemes, digital arrests and sextortion.
impact: No money amounts or victim counts are given in the report.

validation.note: One publisher (Rediff, PTI copy); no police statement read.

evidence.quote: Gurugram Police has arrested 81 persons within a span of 21 days this month
